mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase methylprednisolone metabolism, potentially reducing corticosteroid efficacy, while methylprednisolone may induce cenobamate metabolism affecting seizure control.
action: Monitor corticosteroid and anticonvulsant efficacy closely; consider dose adjustments of methylprednisolone if needed and therapeutic drug monitoring of cenobamate levels when possible.
